title: What I need is a quiet room

questions.context: The team keeps proposing new features. Ana needs time to finish the current ones
questions.prompt: Which sentence puts her real need in focus?

options.text: What we need is time to finish what we’ve started
What we need are as many extra features as possible

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: The what-clause foregrounds the need that the context describes

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: The what-clause foregrounds the need that the context describes

questions.context: Kim didn’t object to the idea; she objected to the cost
questions.prompt: Which correction focuses on that contrast?

options.text: It was the idea that I rejected because it was new
It was the cost that concerned me, not the idea

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: The cleft construction emphasises the specific concern

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: The cleft construction emphasises the specific concern

questions.context: Leo fixed the booking, not the receptionist
questions.prompt: Which sentence stresses who did it?

options.text: What Leo did was ask the receptionist to fix it
It was Leo who sorted out the booking

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: It was Leo who highlights the person responsible

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: It was Leo who highlights the person responsible

questions.context: The delay matters more to Ana than the extra work

options.text: What worries me most is the delay
What worries me most is having any work to do

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Most places the emphasis on the main concern

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Most places the emphasis on the main concern

questions.context: You need a firm date rather than another general update

options.text: What I need is another update whenever possible
What I need is a confirmed date

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: The focused request makes the missing commitment explicit

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: The focused request makes the missing commitment explicit

questions.context: A colleague thinks you want to cancel the launch. You only want to reduce its scope

options.text: What I’m suggesting is a smaller launch, not cancelling it

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A focused correction can distinguish a limited change from a different proposal

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A focused correction can distinguish a limited change from a different proposal

phrases.displayText: I’m sorry, but the room next to the lift is too noisy for me to sleep
phrases.translation: Desculpe, mas o quarto perto do elevador está barulhento demais para eu dormir

phrases.displayText: I’m sorry for the disturbance. We can offer earplugs
phrases.translation: Sinto muito pelo incômodo. Podemos oferecer protetores auriculares

phrases.displayText: Thank you, but what I need is a quiet room. I have an early presentation
phrases.translation: Obrigada, mas preciso de um quarto silencioso. Tenho uma apresentação cedo

phrases.displayText: I understand. Is the problem mainly the lift or the street outside?
phrases.translation: Entendo. O problema é principalmente o elevador ou a rua?

phrases.displayText: It was the lift that woke me repeatedly. The street isn’t the main issue
phrases.translation: Foi o elevador que me acordou repetidamente. A rua não é a questão principal

phrases.displayText: That helps us find a suitable alternative. Have you already asked for a change?
phrases.translation: Isso ajuda a encontrar uma alternativa adequada. Você já pediu uma troca?

phrases.displayText: I did ask this afternoon, but I haven’t had a confirmed option yet
phrases.translation: Pedi esta tarde, mas ainda não recebi uma opção confirmada

phrases.displayText: I can check another room, though it may not be available immediately
phrases.translation: Posso conferir outro quarto, embora talvez não esteja disponível imediatamente

phrases.displayText: Could you tell me when it would be ready and whether it’s away from the lift?
phrases.translation: Pode dizer quando estaria pronto e se fica longe do elevador?

phrases.displayText: Yes. I’ll confirm those details before asking you to move
phrases.translation: Sim. Confirmarei esses detalhes antes de pedir que você se mude

phrases.displayText: I appreciate that. A different room only helps if it solves the noise problem
phrases.translation: Agradeço. Outro quarto só ajuda se resolver o problema do barulho

phrases.displayText: Agreed. I’ll come back with a specific offer rather than another general apology
phrases.translation: Concordo. Voltarei com uma oferta específica em vez de outro pedido genérico de desculpas
